Krenko, Mob Boss.name: Krenko, Mob Boss
Krenko, Mob Boss.flavorText: "Threats? Extortion? Good sir, you have me all wrong. I am a legitimate businessman; my colleagues and I are simply here to conduct legitimate business."

Kaalia of the Vast.name: Kaalia of the Vast
Kaalia of the Vast.flavorText: In the vast emptiness, Kaalia found she was not alone.

Sauron, the Dark Lord.name: Sauron, the Dark Lord

Pantlaza, Sun-Favored.setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

Fire Lord Azula.name: Fire Lord Azula
Fire Lord Azula.flavorText: "I'm sorry it has to end this way, brother."

Giada, Font of Hope.name: Giada, Font of Hope
Giada, Font of Hope.flavorText: Now she is New Capenna's greatest hope.

Nekusar, the Mindrazer.name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
Nekusar, the Mindrazer.flavorText: His enemies wondered if the lich king's brutal death and unnatural rebirth had been his plan all along.

Isshin, Two Heavens as One.name: Isshin, Two Heavens as One
Isshin, Two Heavens as One.flavorText: Trained by the Imperials but disillusioned by their rigidity, he gave his heart—and his swords—to the Asari Uprising.

Miirym, Sentinel Wyrm.setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic.name: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge
Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic.flavorText: "I know this world, from canopy to roots."

Hashaton, Scarab's Fist.name: Hashaton, Scarab's Fist
Hashaton, Scarab's Fist.flavorText: "I served the Scarab in an age long past, in another form, under another name. No matter their visage, I serve."

Flubs, the Fool.name: Flubs, the Fool
Flubs, the Fool.flavorText: He knows exactly where he's going and exactly how he isn't getting there.

Hakbal of the Surging Soul.name: Hakbal of the Surging Soul
Hakbal of the Surging Soul.setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

Muldrotha, the Gravetide.name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
Muldrotha, the Gravetide.flavorText:
"My child grew from rot and ruin, yet she bloomed."
—Multani

Aragorn, the Uniter.name: Aragorn, the Uniter
Aragorn, the Uniter.setName: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth

Arabella, Abandoned Doll.name: Arabella, Abandoned Doll
Arabella, Abandoned Doll.flavorText: Every night, Cori threw the unsettling doll away. Every morning, it was back on the shelf, its eyes following her every move.

Teysa Karlov.name: Teysa Karlov
Teysa Karlov.flavorText: While Kaya is guildmaster, Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power.

Korvold, Fae-Cursed King.name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
Korvold, Fae-Cursed King.flavorText: Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.

Tom Bombadil.name: Tom Bombadil
Tom Bombadil.setName: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth

Kuja, Genome Sorcerer // Trance Kuja, Fa.flavorText: "Peace is but a shadow of death, desperate to forget its painful past..."

Eriette of the Charmed Apple.name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
Eriette of the Charmed Apple.flavorText: "Hush now. I need your beauty sleep."

Captain N'ghathrod.name: Captain N'ghathrod
Captain N'ghathrod.setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements.flavorText: When the world needed him most, the Avatar returned.

Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal.name: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness
Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal.typeLine: Legendary Creature — Elder Dinosaur // Legendary Creature — Phyrexian Elder Dinosaur

Hope Estheim.name: Hope Estheim
Hope Estheim.flavorText: "If we have the power to destroy Cocoon, then we have the power to save it."

Deadpool, Trading Card.name: Deadpool, Trading Card
Deadpool, Trading Card.flavorText: "Draw me like one of your French cards."

Zur the Enchanter.name: Zur the Enchanter
Zur the Enchanter.flavorText: Zur remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent only on his own perfection.

Alela, Artful Provocateur.name: Alela, Artful Provocateur
Alela, Artful Provocateur.flavorText: "Rankle's pranks are child's play. My games will topple kingdoms."

Aesi, Tyrant of Gyre Strait.name: Aesi, Tyrant of Gyre Strait
Aesi, Tyrant of Gyre Strait.flavorText:
"To sail through those waters is to offer oneself as tribute."
—Captain Hoyrik

Norman Osborn // Green Goblin.name: Norman Osborn // Green Goblin
Norman Osborn // Green Goblin.typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Scientist Villain // Legendary Creature — Goblin Human Villain

Fynn, the Fangbearer.name: Fynn, the Fangbearer
Fynn, the Fangbearer.flavorText: "Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost! Or does the great serpent fear a rematch?"

Tovolar, Dire Overlord // Tovolar, the M.name: Tovolar, Dire Overlord // Tovolar, the Midnight Scourge
Tovolar, Dire Overlord // Tovolar, the M.typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Werewolf // Legendary Creature — Werewolf

Zada, Hedron Grinder.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
Zada, Hedron Grinder.flavorText: She pulverizes each hedron and consumes the dust, absorbing the power within.

Marrow-Gnawer.name: Marrow-Gnawer
Marrow-Gnawer.flavorText: Marrow-Gnawer united three nezumi gangs when he slew their leaders in a single night. Now they call him their first lord.

Sythis, Harvest's Hand.name: Sythis, Harvest's Hand
Sythis, Harvest's Hand.flavorText: "Through every verdant field, every bough that hangs heavy with fruit, Karametra shows her love."

Kykar, Wind's Fury.name: Kykar, Wind's Fury
Kykar, Wind's Fury.flavorText: "The raging gale fans the flames of righteous wrath."

Tifa Lockhart.name: Tifa Lockhart
Tifa Lockhart.flavorText: "I'm pretty good at taking care of myself, you know."

Shelob, Child of Ungoliant.name: Shelob, Child of Ungoliant
Shelob, Child of Ungoliant.setName: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth

Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.name: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV
Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.flavorText: The Arbiter is a conduit of justice, a will so disciplined that it dispenses justice without ego or remorse.

Lightning, Army of One.name: Lightning, Army of One
Lightning, Army of One.flavorText: "Lightning. It flashes bright, then fades away. It can't protect. It only destroys."

Temmet, Naktamun's Will.name: Temmet, Naktamun's Will
Temmet, Naktamun's Will.flavorText: Each time he glimpsed oblivion, he learned another lesson.

Yarok, the Desecrated.name: Yarok, the Desecrated
Yarok, the Desecrated.flavorText:
"Yarok grieves within the waste
Of Bala Ged's corrupted land."
—*Lament for Bala Ged*, stanza 1

Rocco, Street Chef.name: Rocco, Street Chef
Rocco, Street Chef.setName: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

Kynaios and Tiro of Meletis.flavorText: "Look what we fought for. Look what we built together."

Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lant.name: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern
Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lant.flavorText: Fear is her one true companion.

Jon Irenicus, Shattered One.name: Jon Irenicus, Shattered One
Jon Irenicus, Shattered One.setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

The Mindskinner.name: The Mindskinner
The Mindskinner.flavorText: It slices away the most precious memories first, then the mundane, until all that remains is blank, formless fear.

Judith, Carnage Connoisseur.name: Judith, Carnage Connoisseur
Judith, Carnage Connoisseur.flavorText: "I don't make my living hiding the truth, detective. I shout it from the stage."

Yurlok of Scorch Thrash.name: Yurlok of Scorch Thrash
Yurlok of Scorch Thrash.flavorText: The gifts of Jund never come without a price.

Alania, Divergent Storm.name: Alania, Divergent Storm
Alania, Divergent Storm.flavorText: "Why would I chase the storm? Does a cloud chase the rain? Does the sun chase the light?"

Cosmic Spider-Man.name: Cosmic Spider-Man
Cosmic Spider-Man.flavorText: The Enigma Force granted Peter the greatest power, and with it, the greatest responsibility.

synergyCards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

Shroofus Sproutsire.name: Shroofus Sproutsire
Shroofus Sproutsire.flavorText: His laughter—and everything else about him—was infectious.

Doran, Besieged by Time.name: Doran, Besieged by Time
Doran, Besieged by Time.flavorText: "Each year that passes rots you with scars. Shelter your heart, for the world is cruel."

Thrasios, Triton Hero.name: Thrasios, Triton Hero
Thrasios, Triton Hero.flavorText: Beneath crashing waves lies an ocean of secrets waiting to be explored.

Kona, Rescue Beastie.name: Kona, Rescue Beastie
Kona, Rescue Beastie.flavorText: She's got a heart of gold, a nose for danger, and jaws that can pulverize a cellarspawn with a single snap.

Child of Alara.name: Child of Alara
Child of Alara.flavorText: The progeny of the Maelstrom shows no allegiance—and no mercy—to any of the five shards.

Narset, Enlightened Exile.name: Narset, Enlightened Exile
Narset, Enlightened Exile.setName: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
Narset, Enlightened Exile.flavorText: They called her unique insight a "gift." Then she saw the truth, and suddenly it was a "threat."

Ojer Axonil, Deepest Might // Temple of.name: Ojer Axonil, Deepest Might // Temple of Power

Anti-Venom, Horrifying Healer.name: Anti-Venom, Horrifying Healer
Anti-Venom, Horrifying Healer.flavorText: "You are a sickness on this city. I am the cure!"

Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin.name: Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin
Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin.setName: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin.flavorText: Stranded on New Capenna without a spark, he faced five families out for blood.

Clavileño, First of the Blessed.name: Clavileño, First of the Blessed
Clavileño, First of the Blessed.setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

Volo, Guide to Monsters.name: Volo, Guide to Monsters
Volo, Guide to Monsters.flavorText: "The beholder told me I had a good eye for details. Who was I to argue?"

Saruman, the White Hand.name: Saruman, the White Hand
Saruman, the White Hand.flavorText: Over all his works a dark smoke hung and wrapped itself about the sides of Orthanc.

Blech, Loafing Pest.name: Blech, Loafing Pest
Blech, Loafing Pest.flavorText: Despite Blex's passing, Witherbloom students still continued the tradition of a yearly search in his honor. His son, however, took little effort to find.

Ketramose, the New Dawn.name: Ketramose, the New Dawn
Ketramose, the New Dawn.flavorText: Let the past die so the future might live.

Shalai and Hallar.name: Shalai and Hallar
Shalai and Hallar.flavorText: Between the angel's blade and the elf's bow, few Phyrexians made it as far as Llanowar's canopy.

Nicol Bolas, the Ravager // Nicol Bolas,.name: Nicol Bolas, the Ravager // Nicol Bolas, the Arisen
Nicol Bolas, the Ravager // Nicol Bolas,.typeLine: Legendary Creature — Elder Dragon // Legendary Planeswalker — Bolas

Omnath, Locus of Mana.name: Omnath, Locus of Mana
Omnath, Locus of Mana.flavorText: It gathers against the coming storm.

Kudo, King Among Bears.name: Kudo, King Among Bears
Kudo, King Among Bears.flavorText: Born from the greatest granite boulder, nursed on the sweetest honey, crowned amid a raging blizzard.

Tannuk, Steadfast Second.name: Tannuk, Steadfast Second
Tannuk, Steadfast Second.flavorText: "We're a few bones short of a skeleton crew, Sami, but we've got plenty of spine."

Rocco, Cabaretti Caterer.name: Rocco, Cabaretti Caterer
Rocco, Cabaretti Caterer.flavorText: They wouldn't admit it, but some people join the Cabaretti just for the food.

Jodah, Archmage Eternal.name: Jodah, Archmage Eternal
Jodah, Archmage Eternal.flavorText:
"Chronicles across the ages describe Jodah. They likely refer not to one mage, but to a family or an arcane title."
—Arkol, Argivian scholar

Queza, Augur of Agonies.name: Queza, Augur of Agonies
Queza, Augur of Agonies.flavorText: Some try to unravel the tangled skeins of fate. She reweaves them to her own deadly design.

Tatyova, Benthic Druid.name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
Tatyova, Benthic Druid.flavorText: "Yavimaya is one being—one vastness of rippling leaves, one deepness of roots, and one chatter of animals—of which I am one part."

Rowan, Scion of War.name: Rowan, Scion of War
Rowan, Scion of War.flavorText: "No more days withering at a negotiating table with my brother. I will rebuild Eldraine myself—the old way, with power."

Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale.name: Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale
Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale.flavorText: Squires throughout the realm aspire to her mix of panache and martial prowess.

Raggadragga, Goreguts Boss.name: Raggadragga, Goreguts Boss
Raggadragga, Goreguts Boss.setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes.name: Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes
Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes.setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

Katara, the Fearless.name: Katara, the Fearless
Katara, the Fearless.flavorText: "I will never, ever turn my back on people who need me!"

Eddie Brock // Venom, Lethal Protector.name: Eddie Brock // Venom, Lethal Protector
Eddie Brock // Venom, Lethal Protector.typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Hero Villain // Legendary Creature — Symbiote Hero Villain
Eddie Brock // Venom, Lethal Protector.flavorText: "I've got the nose for the story. He's got the hunger for the kill. Together..."

Kalamax, the Stormsire.name: Kalamax, the Stormsire
Kalamax, the Stormsire.flavorText: Its mood changes with the weather, and vice versa.

Ghalta, Primal Hunger.name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
Ghalta, Primal Hunger.flavorText: The earth walks, strongest of all.

Norin the Wary.name: Norin the Wary
Norin the Wary.flavorText: "I have a bad feeling about this."

Kess, Dissident Mage.name: Kess, Dissident Mage
Kess, Dissident Mage.flavorText: "Loss has no meaning here. You cannot take from those who have nothing."

Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim.name: Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim
Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim.flavorText: "All will bow to the Whispering One."

Tannuk, Memorial Ensign.name: Tannuk, Memorial Ensign
Tannuk, Memorial Ensign.flavorText: Serving in the Memorial Navy was nothing like the posters made it out to be.

Noctis, Prince of Lucis.name: Noctis, Prince of Lucis
Noctis, Prince of Lucis.flavorText: Many sacrificed all for the King; so must the King sacrifice himself for all.

Ardenn, Intrepid Archaeologist.name: Ardenn, Intrepid Archaeologist
Ardenn, Intrepid Archaeologist.flavorText: "With the right tools, even the sky is within reach."

Xenagos, God of Revels.name: Xenagos, God of Revels
Xenagos, God of Revels.setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

Marwyn, the Nurturer.name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
Marwyn, the Nurturer.flavorText: Midwife to mothers and leader to all.

Zimone, Infinite Analyst.name: Zimone, Infinite Analyst
Zimone, Infinite Analyst.flavorText: "The best answers leave you with more questions."

Xavier Sal, Infested Captain.name: Xavier Sal, Infested Captain
Xavier Sal, Infested Captain.setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

Kellan, the Kid.name: Kellan, the Kid
Kellan, the Kid.flavorText: "I found out who I was. Now it's time to discover who I am."

Myrkul, Lord of Bones.name: Myrkul, Lord of Bones
Myrkul, Lord of Bones.setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

Admiral Brass, Unsinkable.name: Admiral Brass, Unsinkable
Admiral Brass, Unsinkable.setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

Tuvasa the Sunlit.name: Tuvasa the Sunlit
Tuvasa the Sunlit.flavorText: "My people have always been here, and here we shall remain."

Sen Triplets.name: Sen Triplets
Sen Triplets.flavorText: They are the masters of your mind.

Bristly Bill, Spine Sower.name: Bristly Bill, Spine Sower
Bristly Bill, Spine Sower.flavorText: "Wake up, little ones. There's a new day ahead."

Neriv, Heart of the Storm.name: Neriv, Heart of the Storm
Neriv, Heart of the Storm.flavorText: Scales streaked with lightning, trailing thunder in his wake, Neriv is the living banner around which the Mardu rally.

Kadena, Slinking Sorcerer.name: Kadena, Slinking Sorcerer
Kadena, Slinking Sorcerer.flavorText: "The only constant in life is the unknown."

Niv-Mizzet, Visionary.name: Niv-Mizzet, Visionary
Niv-Mizzet, Visionary.flavorText: Ravnica's sharpest mind and its biggest ego.

Gluntch, the Bestower.name: Gluntch, the Bestower
Gluntch, the Bestower.setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

Sméagol, Helpful Guide.name: Sméagol, Helpful Guide
Sméagol, Helpful Guide.setName: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth

Gisa and Geralf.name: Gisa and Geralf
Gisa and Geralf.flavorText:
"These fiends are slightly less tolerable than you."
"A sentiment that warms my heart, sister."

Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood.name: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar
Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood.flavorText: "Join me for the dawn of a new age."

Maha, Its Feathers Night.name: Maha, Its Feathers Night
Maha, Its Feathers Night.flavorText: Its wingspan reaches from dusk to dawn.

Lathiel, the Bounteous Dawn.name: Lathiel, the Bounteous Dawn
Lathiel, the Bounteous Dawn.flavorText: Weeping, the hunter cast aside her bow, struck by the majesty of the creature before her.

Azusa, Lost but Seeking.name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
Azusa, Lost but Seeking.flavorText: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."

Thantis, the Warweaver.name: Thantis, the Warweaver
Thantis, the Warweaver.flavorText: She spins a web few can resist. Its sweet aroma sparks chaos in every heart.

Kiora, Sovereign of the Deep.name: Kiora, Sovereign of the Deep
Kiora, Sovereign of the Deep.setName: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

Sigarda, Font of Blessings.name: Sigarda, Font of Blessings
Sigarda, Font of Blessings.setName: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

Astarion, the Decadent.name: Astarion, the Decadent
Astarion, the Decadent.setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

Pramikon, Sky Rampart.name: Pramikon, Sky Rampart
Pramikon, Sky Rampart.flavorText: Its colors entrance aggressors, directing their violence.

Ayara, First of Locthwain.name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
Ayara, First of Locthwain.flavorText: Mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.

Ozai, the Phoenix King.name: Ozai, the Phoenix King
Ozai, the Phoenix King.flavorText: "Out of the ashes, a new world will be born."

Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain.name: Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain
Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain.flavorText: As she took the wheel of the *Weatherlight* for the first time in a millennium, Jhoira knew she'd been right to restore the ship. Anything was possible now.

Nahiri, Forged in Fury.name: Nahiri, Forged in Fury
Nahiri, Forged in Fury.setName: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

Kwain, Itinerant Meddler.name: Kwain, Itinerant Meddler
Kwain, Itinerant Meddler.flavorText: "Why so slow, why so slow? Hurry up! You never know what you'll find."

Talrand, Sky Summoner.name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
Talrand, Sky Summoner.flavorText: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

Ixhel, Scion of Atraxa.name: Ixhel, Scion of Atraxa
Ixhel, Scion of Atraxa.setName: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander

Imodane, the Pyrohammer.name: Imodane, the Pyrohammer
Imodane, the Pyrohammer.flavorText: "The realm needs a ruler, not a boy playing king."

Elenda, the Dusk Rose.name: Elenda, the Dusk Rose
Elenda, the Dusk Rose.setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

Ayula, Queen Among Bears.name: Ayula, Queen Among Bears
Ayula, Queen Among Bears.flavorText: Born from the oldest red cedar, nursed on the sap of the tallest spruce, coronated under the mightiest pine.

Zurgo, Thunder's Decree.name: Zurgo, Thunder's Decree
Zurgo, Thunder's Decree.flavorText: "Hear me, Mardu! Our freedom is only beginning!"

Ognis, the Dragon's Lash.name: Ognis, the Dragon's Lash
Ognis, the Dragon's Lash.flavorText: Ziatora's second-in-command has a habit of appearing when and where her enemies least expect her.

Juri, Master of the Revue.name: Juri, Master of the Revue
Juri, Master of the Revue.flavorText: "What a show! We're going to make a killing tonight."

Don Andres, the Renegade.name: Don Andres, the Renegade
Don Andres, the Renegade.setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
Don Andres, the Renegade.flavorText: "Why climb the tangled rigging of the Legion of Dusk's hierarchy when I can fly a free flag of my own?"

Duskana, the Rage Mother.name: Duskana, the Rage Mother
Duskana, the Rage Mother.flavorText:
"A pale bear shall herald the rise of the old gods."
—Gruul prophecy

Sorin of House Markov // Sorin, Ravenous.name: Sorin of House Markov // Sorin, Ravenous Neonate
Sorin of House Markov // Sorin, Ravenous.typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Noble // Legendary Planeswalker — Sorin

synergyCards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

Marisi, Breaker of the Coil.name: Marisi, Breaker of the Coil
Marisi, Breaker of the Coil.flavorText: "Cast off the law! Awaken your rage!"

Clive, Ifrit's Dominant // Ifrit, Warden.name: Clive, Ifrit's Dominant // Ifrit, Warden of Inferno
Clive, Ifrit's Dominant // Ifrit, Warden.typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Noble Warrior // Legendary Enchantment Creature — Saga Demon

Marchesa, Dealer of Death.name: Marchesa, Dealer of Death
Marchesa, Dealer of Death.flavorText: "You should have folded when you had the chance."

Karador, Ghost Chieftain.name: Karador, Ghost Chieftain
Karador, Ghost Chieftain.flavorText: "Death tried to uncrown me. But now I return, king of a greater realm."

Narci, Fable Singer.name: Narci, Fable Singer
Narci, Fable Singer.flavorText: "All stories eventually come to an end."

Abaddon the Despoiler.name: Abaddon the Despoiler
Abaddon the Despoiler.flavorText: Under his rule, there is but one creed: Chaos shall reign.

Ardbert, Warrior of Darkness.name: Ardbert, Warrior of Darkness
Ardbert, Warrior of Darkness.flavorText: "Always we took the burden of fighting upon ourselves. That's what heroes do, isn't it?"

Greasefang, Okiba Boss.name: Greasefang, Okiba Boss
Greasefang, Okiba Boss.flavorText: It's hard to say which is more deadly: her bike or her bite.

Jasmine Boreal of the Seven.name: Jasmine Boreal of the Seven
Jasmine Boreal of the Seven.flavorText: "I've had my adventures. All I wish now is to sit in peace and speak with the pines."

Wayta, Trainer Prodigy.name: Wayta, Trainer Prodigy
Wayta, Trainer Prodigy.setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

Delney, Streetwise Lookout.name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout
Delney, Streetwise Lookout.flavorText: "It's not a matter of what I know. It's a matter of making it worth my while to tell you."

Anhelo, the Painter.name: Anhelo, the Painter
Anhelo, the Painter.flavorText: Every work of art is a hit.

Slimefoot, the Stowaway.name: Slimefoot, the Stowaway
Slimefoot, the Stowaway.flavorText: As Jhoira restored the *Weatherlight*, a mushroom growing in its hold unexpectedly became her first crew member.

Ral, Monsoon Mage // Ral, Leyline Prodig.name: Ral, Monsoon Mage // Ral, Leyline Prodigy
Ral, Monsoon Mage // Ral, Leyline Prodig.typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Wizard // Legendary Planeswalker — Ral
